v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: Make a joyful noise * before the Lord our King.
Lord, * thou hast been our refuge. ‡
O Lord, * thy mercy is in heaven.

text.la: Pópulus meus, * ait Dóminus, bonis meis adimplébitur.
text.en: My people, * said the Lord, shall be filled with good things.
To our God * be joyful and fitting praise.

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: In sanctitáte * serviámus Dómino, et liberábit nos ab inimícis nostris.
text.en: In holiness * let us serve the Lord, and he will deliver us from our enemies.

text.la: Largíre, quǽsumus, Dómine, fidélibus tuis indulgéntiam placátus et pacem: ut páriter ab ómnibus mundéntur offénsis, et secúra tibi mente desérviant.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, O Lord, to thy faithful people pardon and peace, that they may be cleansed from all their sins, and serve thee with a quiet mind.

text.la: Qui odit ánimam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam ætérnam custódit eam.
text.en: He that hateth his life in this world, shall keep it unto life eternal.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Gregem tuum, Pastor ætérne, placátus inténde: et, per beátum Evarístum Mártyrem tuum atque Summum Pontíficem, perpétua protectióne custódi; quem totíus Ecclésiæ præstitísti esse pastórem.
text.en: Look forgivingly on thy flock, Eternal Shepherd, and keep it in thy constant protection, by the intercession of blessed Evaristus thy Martyr and Sovereign Pontiff, whom thou didst constitute Shepherd of the whole Church.

office.title: Feria Quinta infra Hebd XX post Octavam Pentecostes IV. Octobris
